name: transfer_ends_the_call
about: A transfer tool says its line, puts the caller through on the call's phone line, and ends the call with no model reply after it. The call ends as transferred.
instructions: You help callers with their orders. Transfer them to billing when they ask.

turns.caller: Put me through to billing, please.

model.prompt: You help callers with their orders. Transfer them to billing when they ask.

spoken: Putting you through now, one moment.
